name: Emergency Plan
description: The household's emergency plan, kept on this computer: who is in the household with their numbers and medical notes, an out-of-area contact and other people to call, meeting places, where the shutoffs, kit and papers are, how to leave and what to grab, pets, the hazards that apply here, and a log of drills and reviews. It scores how complete the plan is, prints the plan and wallet cards, and the bot can answer from it with no internet. It does not track supplies (Prep Supplies does that), does not send alerts or reminders, and has no maps.
author: Cypher Sisters

tools.show_plan: Read out the household emergency plan: the whole plan, or one section (people, contacts, meeting places, home, leaving, grab list, pets, hazards, practice).
tools.find_contact: Find who to call from the emergency plan, by need: the out-of-area contact everyone checks in with, a nearby helper, the doctor, the vet, school, work, insurance, a utility, or a person in the household.
tools.where_is: Say where something is, from the emergency plan: the water, gas and power shutoffs and how to turn them off, fire extinguishers, first aid kit, go-bags, spare keys, important papers, safe spots, ways out, meeting places, pet carriers and routes out of the area.
tools.update_plan: Set or change one item in a section of the emergency plan: a person's details, a contact, a meeting place, a home detail, a leaving detail, a grab list item, a pet, or a hazard and what we do. An item that is not there yet is added. For the out-of-area contact, set kind to out_of_area.
tools.readiness_check: Score how complete the emergency plan is, out of 8 plain checks, and list what is missing.
tools.grab_list: Show the grab list of things to take when leaving home in a hurry, or tick or untick one item on it as packed.
tools.log_practice: Log a drill or a review of the emergency plan: the date, what was practiced and what to fix. A review also sets the plan's last reviewed date.
tools.remove_item: When the owner wants something taken out of the emergency plan, remove it by its name, no need to look it up first: a person's details, a contact, a meeting place, a home or leaving detail, a grab list item, a pet, a hazard note, or a practice log entry.

show_plan: what does our emergency plan say about pets
where_is: where do we meet if we can't get home
update_plan: set Sam's mobile in the emergency plan to 555-0100
our meeting place in the neighborhood is the library on Elm Street
readiness_check: how ready is our emergency plan
what is our emergency plan missing
grab_list: what is on our grab list
tick the phone chargers on the grab list
log_practice: we did a fire drill today; next time Jo needs a flashlight by the bed
log a review of the emergency plan
remove_item: remove Biscuit from the pets in our emergency plan
take the old insurance contact out of the emergency plan

consent: Emergency Plan keeps your household's emergency plan, with the phone numbers and medical notes you type, in its own folder on this computer (plan.json); it uses no internet and does not use the brain. The bot can read and change the plan when you ask it in chat, and the file is not encrypted by this app.
